key_insight: fix: three compass CLI bugs — computeScore NaN, propose --from-last, NO_LLM_CMDS (v3.0.3)
outcome:
Three bugs found by code review of `bin/commands/compass.js`. All introduced when compass was originally written as a self-contained CLI file.

## Bug 1 — `computeScore` produces `NaN` silently

If the LLM omits any score dimension, `undefined * 20 = NaN`. The total becomes `NaN`, corrupting all scored output (`pathways`, `bets`, `score`) with no visible error.

**Fix:** `?? 0` fallback on every dimension.
